compat_notes: Node >=22.12.0. No custom 404 page. The newsletter form posts to site-config subscribe.form.action (default '#') and needs a separate provider (Mailchimp/Formspree/ConvertKit). No host config files. No Staticfile needed: astro.config sets no outDir, so the build writes to Astro's default dist (verified in the build), which is the folder node_static serves.
policy: No CONTRIBUTING, PR template or AI policy; no JustGoodUI/.github repo. Closed PR #60 'add deploy configuration' came from a non-member fork and added a GitHub Pages workflow plus a stray file. It looks like a mistaken PR, not a maintainer refusal; I could not read its comment. No existing Wasmer PR or issue.
why: The README leads with a Deploy to Netlify button; the theme is a fully static Astro blog built to dist.
